message.content: In discussions about the potential features of the game, LiHua expresses enthusiasm for the idea of stealth mechanics. During a conversation with Thane Chambers, LiHua mentions, "I’d love to see some stealth boosts! Being able to sneak past enemies or get the jump on them adds a whole new layer to gameplay. It could really open up some unique gameplay experiences." LiHua believes that including stealth elements would provide players with a fresh and engaging gameplay experience, adding an element of strategy and excitement. She further elaborates, "Doing stealth missions as a team could lead to some hilarious or epic moments. Trying to coordinate our moves without alerting enemies would make for some fun gameplay. I hope the game incorporates that well!" This indicates that LiHua is eager to see how stealth mechanics would be integrated into the game, particularly in terms of cooperative play.
